title: fix: make failed portal lists retryable
body:
## What Problem This Solves

A failed first portal-list request shows start-a-portal instructions alongside the error and offers no Retry. Portals also needs to present asynchronous reads and close operations through the native Solid 2 primitives without moving request authority out of its existing owner.

## User Impact

The first list failure now shows a working Retry action. While retrying, the page shows Loading; after a successful list, refreshes and same-client reconnects retain the selected preview and its iframe document. Rejected close operations restore the close control and keep the preview visible.

## Why This Change Was Made

The plain owner exposes its admitted list receipt and a separate first-success fact; its existing `loading`/`loaded` facts remain authoritative for `ui.command.result` acknowledgements. Native Loading/Errored boundaries observe that receipt. A scoped generator action supplies optimistic close presentation while the owner keeps permissions, admission, settlement, ordered events, selection, polling, and reachability diagnosis.

Gateway retirement releases both read and action presentation. Native target or hidden intent releases held action presentation without pretending an admitted first read has completed. The existing keyed rows, iframe key, route import, context, host properties, and ResizeObserver remain with their current owners.

## Evidence

- Final independent Codex review through P2 confirmed the preview-lifetime correction and found no additional actionable defects in the complete candidate. The identified old-index defect is resolved by the committed correction.
- UI typecheck, touched-file lint/format, controller census, and diff hygiene passed.
- Production-build browser proof passed for a held first read, hide/reveal during that read, first-read failure, held Retry, successful preview, retained iframe during refresh and same-client reconnect, rejected close recovery, and no page errors.
- Exact-base normalized production builds passed. Strict paired performance comparison reported zero violations. Gzip bytes, base → candidate: startup **316216 → 316199**, Chat **1439299 → 1439233**, New Session **1016204 → 1016122**.
- Canonical `pnpm deadcode:knip` (`--files --dependencies`) reports the same 13 unused heartbeat files on the exact base and candidate, all outside this scope. No new unused files or dependencies; the base additionally reports `eslint` in `tools/solid-lint`, which the candidate does not report. This evidence is retained for the runtime-only preview-key correction, which changes no imports, exports, or files in the dependency graph.
- The focused Portals page suite passes **24/24** with the repository-pinned Bun runtime. The initial local startup stall was resolved on the subsequent targeted CI-failure reproduction; no alternate unit runtime was used.
- [CI run 39745177421](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39745177421) caught three identity-retirement regressions: a retained loading region kept the old iframe across a client, account, or recovery replacement. All three reproduced locally. The owner now advances a preview key only when its Gateway data is reset, and the keyed subtree disposes that old preview. The unchanged tests pass, while same-client reconnect still retains the frame.

### Solid checklist

| Item | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Native handlers | Stable callbacks read current props and owner state. |
| Lifecycle | Synchronous Gateway/event subscriptions and host owner registration remain: deferring setup would lose native property events and retirement. ResizeObserver already has paired onSettled setup/cleanup. |
| Async reads | Native Loading/Errored observes the existing admitted request; no duplicate RPC owner. Existing loaded/loading facts keep acknowledgement semantics. |
| Mutations | Scoped generator action, optimistic closing ID, and affected readiness; the plain owner retains admission and recorded outcomes. |
| Code splitting | The existing route loader remains the lazy boundary. |
| Structured state | Read the plain owner projection and retain keyed rows; no writable owner mirror. |
| JSX | Existing TSX stays canonical. |
| Context | Existing default-less application context; no new wrapper. |
| Sibling loading | Environment status and portal preview are exclusive modes, so no Reveal group. Probe status remains the owner's acknowledgement diagnosis. |
| Owner APIs | No createRoot, getOwner, or runWithOwner added. |

Across the whole Portals family, production LOC is **1087 → 1257** and test LOC is **634 → 656** (the page test alone is 544 → 566). The nine measured imperative-smell counts remain **0 → 0**: rendering controllers, createEffect, createRenderEffect, untrack, direct listeners, DOM queries, class strings, flush, and owner APIs. The added code supplies first-read readiness, retry, and scoped action lifetime; it does not add a second authoritative store. Release-note context is this PR; no changelog edit.

### Before and after

The before capture shows the first-list failure mixed with start-a-portal instructions. The after capture shows the same synthetic failure with Retry and the retained page header.

![After: failed portal list with Retry](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/82d1d482-276e-47a4-9c79-f528978c7d00)
